rows.text: builds a local record of dword 0 at `+0`, sign-extended `ecx` at qword `+8` and sign-extended `edx` at qword `+0x10`, calls `002899A0` + 0x41(`0xd0`, the address `0028B860`, address of that record), then copies bit 0 of `r8d` into bit `0x2` of dword `+0xc4` of the returned object (AND with `0xfffffffd`, then OR of (`r8d` AND 1)*2); the frame carries a stack cookie from qword `01F44830` checked through `002899A0` + 0x60

notes: 002899A0: 0028B860 is passed as a code-address argument (lea), not called here; it is named because the listing resolves it, and FABLE may prefer to describe it without the address if that imports a callee into the host. r9d is not read.
